<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_MarketingCampaign" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/marketing-campaign">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing Campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_MarketingCampaign">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MarketingTeam" name="Marketing Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Campaign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DefineObjectives</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateContent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DesignVisuals</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectChannels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LaunchCampaign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TrackPerformance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CampaignPeriodEnds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnalyzePerformance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_PerformanceAnalyzed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CRMSystem" name="CRM System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectLeads</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesTeam" name="Sales Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FollowUpLeads</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Campaign" name="Campaign planning begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define campaign objectives, audience, and goals"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Create campaign content"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DesignVisuals" name="Design campaign visuals"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Select promotion channels"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track campaign performance in real time"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectLeads" name="Collect campaign leads in CRM"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUpLeads" name="Follow up campaign leads"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" name="Campaign period ends">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze campaign performance for future optimization"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PerformanceAnalyzed" name="Campaign performance analyzed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Define" sourceRef="StartEvent_Campaign" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Define_Content" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Task_CreateContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Content_Visuals" sourceRef="Task_CreateContent" targetRef="Task_DesignVisuals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visuals_Channels" sourceRef="Task_DesignVisuals" targetRef="Task_SelectChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channels_Launch" sourceRef="Task_SelectChannels" targetRef="Task_LaunchCampaign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Launch_Track" sourceRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Task_TrackPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Track_Collect" sourceRef="Task_TrackPerformance" targetRef="Task_CollectLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_FollowUp" sourceRef="Task_CollectLeads" targetRef="Task_FollowUpLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FollowUp_PeriodEnd" sourceRef="Task_FollowUpLeads" targetRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PeriodEnd_Analyze" sourceRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" targetRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Analyze_End" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_PerformanceAnalyzed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
